name: files_list
title: List files
description: Files in a folder the assistant may use, newest first (up to 2000). Hidden files and links are skipped. (Permission: read.)

folder.description: A folder inside the allowed ones; default the first allowed folder.

name: drawing_open
title: Open a drawing
description: Open a DWG or DXF drawing with CadCraft. Returns a handle (d1, …) for the other drawing tools and a short summary. (Permission: read.)

path.description: A file inside the folders the assistant may use (relative = inside the first one).

name: drawing_new
title: Start a new drawing
description: A new, empty drawing in memory (save it with drawing_save and a path). (Permission: edit.)

name: drawing_describe
title: Describe a drawing
description: Units and length format, extents, the layer table (state and object counts), blocks and their uses, objects by type, sheets with their viewports, views, notes from reading the file. (Permission: read.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: objects_list
title: List objects
description: Objects in an open drawing, filtered and paged: each with its id, type, layer, colour, geometry, length/area where it has one, and a one-line description. Coordinates are drawing units. (Permission: read.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

within.description: Only objects entirely inside this box.

countOnly.description: Only the total, by type and by layer (no objects).

name: object_get
title: Get one object
description: One object in full (every field, block attributes and the block definition of a reference). (Permission: read.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: drawing_check
title: Check against standards
description: Check a drawing against layer and drafting rules: layers.allowed (names or /regex/), layers.required, layers.noObjectsOn, objects.colorByLayer / linetypeByLayer / lineweightByLayer, objects.textHeights, objects.textStyles, blocks.noUnused, units.lunits / units.insunits. Returns each finding with the ids it concerns. (Permission: read.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: command_run
title: Run a CadCraft command
description: Type at CadCraft's command line: one string, or a list where each item answers the next prompt ("" = Enter). Items may also be {pick: [x, y]}, {window: [x1, y1, x2, y2], crossing}, {entity: id} or {escape: true}. Example: ["LINE", "0,0", "@100,0", "@0,50", ""]. A command still waiting at the end is ended with Esc unless keepOpen. One string is read as typed at the command line: each line and each space ends an answer, as Space does there (two spaces = an empty answer; a text prompt takes the rest of the line), e.g. "LINE 0,0 @100,0 @0,50 " (the last space ends LINE). A list gives one answer per item instead. The whole call is one undo step labelled "Assistant: …". Commands that need a dialog on screen are refused. (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

select.description: Object ids selected before the command (noun-verb).

items.description: A file inside the folders the assistant may use (relative = inside the first one).

openFiles.description: Files (inside the allowed folders) that answer the file questions the commands ask, in order: INSERT F, XATTACH, ASBUILT's point file.

keepOpen.description: Leave a command that still waits after the last answer open (the result says what it waits for); the next command_run with continue: true answers it. Each call is still one undo step.

continue.description: Answer the command a keepOpen call left waiting, instead of starting at the command prompt.

name: script_run
title: Run a script
description: On a drawing: run a script as one undo step, language "scr" (command-line lines, as a .scr file) or "lisp" (AutoLISP-style, run by CadCraft's own interpreter; (command …) drives CadCraft's commands). On a part (part_open): a CraftScript ("craft", the default there), Lua or Python script, sealed (no files, no network), with `part` = the built solid and param()/params() its parameters; it prints and displays, the part does not change. Lua and Python need their runtimes beside these tools (the repository), CraftScript runs everywhere. (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: block_insert
title: Insert a block
description: Unavailable in this standalone BimCraft distribution: the CadCraft application modules are not installed. No drawing is changed. (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: undo
title: Undo
description: Undo the assistant's last steps on a drawing, an IFC model, a civil site, a part or a takeoff (only steps labelled "Assistant:" unless any is true). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: drawing_save
title: Save a drawing
description: Write the drawing: to its own file (default) or to a new .dwg/.dxf path. format dwg | dxf2000 | dxf (R12); DWG version 2000, 2004, 2007, 2010, 2013 or 2018 (default 2018). (Permission: save.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

path.description: A file inside the folders the assistant may use (relative = inside the first one).

overwrite.description: Replace a file that already exists (and was not opened or written in this session).

name: doc_close
title: Close a file
description: Forget an open drawing, model or takeoff (unsaved changes are dropped). (Permission: read.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: ifc_open
title: Open an IFC model
description: Open an IFC model (IFC2X3, IFC4, IFC4X3) for questions: schema, project, storeys, element classes. Geometry is not built. (Permission: read.)

path.description: A file inside the folders the assistant may use (relative = inside the first one).

name: ifc_query
title: Find IFC elements
description: Elements of an open IFC model by class (subclasses included, e.g. IfcWall finds IfcWallStandardCase), storey name, name (contains) and a property (its set optional; equals or contains; type properties count). Paged. (Permission: read.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: ifc_properties
title: IFC element properties
description: Attributes, property sets and quantities of one element (by its line id from ifc_query), and its type's property sets. (Permission: read.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: ifc_new
title: Start a new building
description: A new IFC4 building in memory, as BimCraft's File › New building makes it: a site, a building and levels (default 2 levels, 3000 mm apart). Draw in it with walls_add and the other BimCraft tools, then save it with ifc_save and a path. (Permission: edit.)

name: materials_list
title: Inspect project materials
description: Stable material IDs, exact defaults in mm, version diagnostics. Reads never migrate or write records. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: read.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: assemblies_list
title: Inspect wall assemblies
description: Built-in and authored wall keys, stored type GlobalIds, exact exterior-to-interior recipes and core flags in mm. Invalid records are diagnostics, never selectable fallbacks. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: read.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: material_create
title: material_create
description: Create a project material; retain unused definitions. One atomic Assistant undo step. Values are mm. Requires the inspected documentId and revision. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

defaultThickness.description: mm. A library default; never resizes existing recipe layers.

name: material_edit
title: material_edit
description: Edit an explicitly identified project material; defaults do not change instance layer widths. One atomic Assistant undo step. Values are mm. Requires the inspected documentId and revision. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

defaultThickness.description: mm. A library default; never resizes existing recipe layers.

name: assembly_create
title: assembly_create
description: Create an unused authored assembly. Layers have explicit material IDs and mm widths. One atomic Assistant undo step. Values are mm. Requires the inspected documentId and revision. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

t.description: Explicit mm; zero only for material membranes.

layers.description: Ordered exterior to interior. One contiguous physical core.

name: assembly_edit
title: assembly_edit
description: Edit an authored assembly in place; ALL instances of that type follow, preserving their location anchors. One atomic Assistant undo step. Values are mm. Requires the inspected documentId and revision. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

t.description: Explicit mm; zero only for material membranes.

layers.description: Ordered exterior to interior. One contiguous physical core.

name: assembly_duplicate
title: assembly_duplicate
description: Copy a discovered built-in or authored assembly to a new key and GlobalId. No instance is assigned implicitly. One atomic Assistant undo step. Values are mm. Requires the inspected documentId and revision. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: walls_edit
title: walls_edit
description: Change only walls identified by GlobalId, including authored type assignment, six location lines, exterior side and existing height/top settings. No join/end or reference-dimension editing. One atomic Assistant undo step. Values are mm. Requires the inspected documentId and revision. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

type.description: Dynamic key from assemblies_list or model_describe; no built-in fallback.

topLevel.description: Exact storey GlobalId. Mutually exclusive with height.

name: wall_joins_get
title: Inspect wall joins
description: Persisted/effective A/B controls, record classification, raw-mm physical profiles and full-neighborhood diagnostics. Eligibility does not certify cleaned joining. Reads never migrate. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: read.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: wall_join_diagnostics
title: Inspect join diagnostics
description: Exactly one of walls or storey GlobalId. Inspect complete participating storeys, then filter. Stable codes, raw mm; no guessed neighbors or end IDs. Never migrates records. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: read.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: wall_join_end_set
title: Change one wall end
description: Change allow/cap on stable analytic end a or b using changeWall, regeneration and ordinary history. Internal node/tee relations and untouched end are retained. Same values on absent/legacy records explicitly migrate in one undoable step; supported same values are a no-op. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: model_describe
title: Describe the model
description: The open BimCraft model in millimetres: its levels (name, GlobalId, elevation, height), walls by type, doors, windows, rooms with their areas, floors drawn by outline, ramps, grid line tags, columns and the site; also the wall, door and window types walls_add and opening_add take. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: read.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: walls_list
title: List walls
description: The walls on a level that BimCraft's Draw tools can change: GlobalId, start and end (mm, in the level's plan), type, thickness, height, length, and the doors and windows in each. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: read.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

level.description: A level by its name or GlobalId (default: the level at elevation 0, else the lowest).

name: walls_add
title: Add walls
description: Walls along points (mm, in the level's plan) on a level, joined to each other and to the walls there; rooms, floors and roofs follow as with the Wall tool. closed: true runs the last wall back to the first point. Type: one of model_describe's wall types (default ext-2x6). Height: mm, or leave it out to run up to the level above (the level's height on the top level). One undo step. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

level.description: A level by its name or GlobalId (default: the level at elevation 0, else the lowest).

type.description: Dynamic key from assemblies_list or model_describe; no built-in fallback.

topLevel.description: Exact storey GlobalId. Mutually exclusive with height.

name: opening_add
title: Add a door or window
description: A door or window in a wall (its GlobalId from walls_list or walls_add): type from model_describe (default a single door / a fixed window), offset = mm from the wall's start to the opening's near edge (default: the middle), width and height in mm (default: the type's), sill for windows. Refused if it does not fit. One undo step. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: floor_add
title: Add a floor
description: A floor or slab of any outline (mm, in the level's plan; at least three corners, not crossing itself) on a level: kind concrete | wood, use floor | slab, thickness in mm (default the kind's), offset = its top above the level (mm). One undo step. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

level.description: A level by its name or GlobalId (default: the level at elevation 0, else the lowest).

name: levels_add
title: Add levels
description: Levels at these heights above the lowest level (mm); a height a level already has is skipped. Names follow the model's ("Level 3"). One undo step. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: grid_add
title: Add grid lines
description: Grid lines laid out as Build › Grid does: numbered lines (u: count and spacing in mm, a number or one per bay) and lettered lines (v), from an origin (mm, in the level's plan), turned by angle (degrees), each running extend mm past the last crossing. Added to the model's grid (one per building). One undo step. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

level.description: A level by its name or GlobalId (default: the level at elevation 0, else the lowest).

name: element_set
title: Set a name or property
description: Change one element (by GlobalId): an attribute (Name, Description, ObjectType, Tag), or one property value by its name (and set name, when two sets have it). The value keeps the property's IFC type (numbers stay numbers). A value the element shares with others is copied for it first; a property of the element's type changes every element of that type and needs type: true. One undo step. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: elements_delete
title: Delete elements
description: Delete elements by GlobalId, as one undo step. Walls, doors, windows and floors drawn with BimCraft's tools go through the Draw module (walls close up, rooms and joins follow); any other element goes with its parts and openings. Levels, the building and the site are not deleted. Drawn and other elements go in separate calls. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: elements_move
title: Move elements
description: Move elements (by GlobalId) by [dx, dy, dz] millimetres in the model's axes (x east, y north, z up on an unturned model), as one undo step; what is hosted on them or placed relative to them moves along. A wall drawn with BimCraft's tools moves with wall_change (its ends), a door or window along its wall with opening_change. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: wall_change
title: Change a wall
description: Change a wall drawn with BimCraft's tools (GlobalId from walls_list): its start a and end b (mm, in its level's plan) and/or its type. Joined walls, rooms and its doors and windows follow; a door that no longer fits refuses the change. One undo step. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

type.description: Dynamic key from assemblies_list or model_describe; no built-in fallback.

name: opening_change
title: Change a door or window
description: Change a door or window (GlobalId): offset = mm from its wall's start to its near edge, width, height, sill (windows), type (of the same kind), or wall = another wall's GlobalId to move it there. Refused if it does not fit. One undo step. Works on an IFC model opened with ifc_open or ifc_new (doc). (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: redo
title: Redo an IFC edit
description: Redo an Assistant-owned IFC model step; a person step requires any: true. (Permission: edit.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: ifc_save
title: Save an IFC model
description: Write an IFC model with every change: to its own file (default) or a new .ifc path. (Permission: save.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

path.description: A file inside the folders the assistant may use (relative = inside the first one).

overwrite.description: Replace a file that already exists (and was not opened or written in this session).

name: takeoff_open
title: Open a takeoff
description: Open a TakeoffCraft project (.takeoff.json: items, marks, the PDFs or drawings it was measured on and their scales), or start a new takeoff on a DWG / DXF drawing (its sheets: Model, then each layout, scaled from the drawing's units and viewports as TakeoffCraft does). `drawings`: the .dwg / .dxf files a saved takeoff was made on (matched by their SHA-256), for the cad_* tools. (Permission: read.)

path.description: A file inside the folders the assistant may use (relative = inside the first one).

items.description: A file inside the folders the assistant may use (relative = inside the first one).

name: takeoff_quantities
title: Takeoff quantities
description: Quantities per item (in its unit) or per sheet. Marks on sheets with no scale are listed as unscaled, never counted as zero. (Permission: read.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: takeoff_estimate
title: Takeoff estimate
description: The priced estimate as TakeoffCraft computes it: a row per item and per assembly component (quantity, waste, material and labor), totals in cents and as text; incomplete when a formula fails or marks are unscaled. (Permission: read.)

doc.description: A handle from drawing_open, ifc_open, takeoff_open, site_open or part_open.

name: markups_list
title: List PDF markups
description: The sheets of a PDF and its markups as MarkupCraft reads them (type, sheet, text, comment, status, author, dates, punch item, replies), filtered and paged. Annotations from other programs that MarkupCraft cannot edit are marked readOnly. (Permission: read.)

path.description: A file inside the folders the assistant may use (relative = inside the first one).
